'''2011 Tatooine Regionals Chris Fanchi LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Fanchi]] at [[2011 Tatooine Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates|Ref3-L-wellhandlethis.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' ChrisF
* '''Deck name:''' An Irishman walks outta bar
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
